fusions.name: Price of the Scent
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Final Pass
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 34 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It also deals 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Scent Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Circle
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
